newsitem.title: UK: On Demand, Miller Freeman in online deal.
newsitem.headline: On Demand, Miller Freeman in online deal.

text.p: On Demand Information Plc and Miller Freeman Plc, the business information unit of United News & Media signed an agreement to launch a series of online services.
The companies said they would create a market place service to bring buyers and sellers together via Internet (2), a second generation network.
Internet (2) is an ISDN service which makes available high resolution graphics, full motion videos and can help hold teleconferences with the voice & view function.
The services by On Demand and Miller Freeman would cater to 40 industry sectors based on 200,000 British firms sourced in association with Dun & Bradstreet.
Revenues would be derived from firms placing information on their products and services.
Users of the information would pay an annual subscription which includes access to the ordinary Internet at 128k and e-mail services.
